details: Bitcoin is hovering around $63,000, experiencing a slight decline despite recent positive inflows into US-listed spot Bitcoin Exchange Traded Funds (ETFs). BlackRock's IBIT led with over $180 million in net purchases, contributing to a total of $233 million in net inflows for Bitcoin ETFs on July 30, turning weekly and monthly flows positive. This comes amidst general market corrections and geopolitical tensions.
title: Bitcoin Trades Near $63K as ETF Inflows Rebound

details: Ethereum has fallen below the $1,900 mark, with its price reportedly at $1,899.4 USDT, down 0.47% in the last 24 hours. The broader cryptocurrency market is experiencing corrections due to macro uncertainty and escalating geopolitical tensions, putting altcoins like Ethereum under selling pressure.
title: Ethereum Price Tumbles Below $1,900 Amid Market Downturn

details: Stablecoin issuer Tether announced a significant $1.5 billion profit in the second quarter of 2026. The company also revealed it has accumulated 98,932 Bitcoins, indicating a strong financial position and a continued strategy of holding BTC.
title: Tether Posts $1.5 Billion Q2 Profit, Accumulates 98,932 Bitcoins

details: A security vulnerability in Coldcard Mk3 hardware wallets has reportedly led to the theft of $30 million in Bitcoin from users. The attacker targeted large wallets within a short 10-minute window. Coinkite, the maker of Coldcard, has issued warnings to affected users.
title: Coldcard Wallet Vulnerability Exposes Users, $30M Bitcoin Stolen

details: Decentralized exchange Uniswap has launched "Earn" in partnership with Morpho, allowing users to earn yield on their idle crypto assets through new lending vaults. This development expands DeFi opportunities on the Uniswap platform.
title: Uniswap Introduces "Earn" with Morpho Lending for Yield Generation

details: Macro investor Arthur Hayes sold 2,364.38 ETH for $4.3 million USDC, incurring a reported loss of $241,000. This move, observed during a general crypto market decline, has generated discussion among investors, especially given Hayes's previous support for Ethereum.
title: Arthur Hayes Sells Ethereum at a $241K Loss Amid Market Slide
